resources.string: A floating Android companion for playful "move faster" taps.

Grant overlay permission, start the overlay, then switch to Doubao. The floating bubble can be dragged anywhere and tapped for haptic feedback and a quick "speed up" message. This first version does not automate another app yet.
Tip: the first launch is easiest if you keep this screen open until the overlay appears.
Overlay permission is required before the bubble can float above Doubao.
Overlay started. Switch to Doubao and tap the bubble when it gets too philosophical.
The floating bubble is ready on top of other apps.
Tap when the reply is taking forever.
